tasks.short: Read electromechanical drawings to determine parts and assembly sequence

steps.what: Retrieve the correct blueprint, specifications and variant bill of materials
Read blueprint geometry, symbols and component requirements
Cross-reference explicit component identifiers with the released bill of materials
Check component matches and determine the electromechanical assembly sequence

tasks.design: Use the production job's native document links in {OPS_SYSTEM} to retrieve the correct released material and match explicit component identifiers to its bill of materials. The assembler reads the drawings, resolves unmatched references and determines the actual assembly sequence; the system does not infer geometry or approve substitutions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate document navigation and identifier cross-checking interrupt drawing interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing production jobs can link released variants, drawings and part identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing ambiguities, fit, access and sequence constraints require technical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler recognises an impractical sequence or a wrong component despite a matching identifier.
tasks.altitude: Technical interpretation and component decisions stay with the assembler.

evidence.claim: Azumuta supports variant-specific instructions linked to production jobs; its case does not establish this task's time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is reading released drawings and determining parts and sequence, before physical assembly. No new production report, component order or automatic instruction release is introduced.

Engineering already produces job variant, drawing identifier/revision, part identifier, quantity and released bill-of-materials status in the production module of OPS_SYSTEM. s1 verifies the release and resolves absent links manually. s2 includes reading and, where necessary, manually selecting or entering the explicit component references for s3. No uncounted drawing extraction or supplier capture is assumed.

Test native document links and bill-of-materials cross-reference before code. s1 removes three points of navigation only and retains 12 points of document validation. s3 replaces explicit identifier comparisons, not deciding which part a drawing depicts. s4 retains full component/quantity checking, manual unmatched-reference comparison and sequence determination; excess exception effort lowers the estimate.

A prototype with only a drawing and no released component identifiers cannot use the same cross-reference saving; its manual interpretation remains. Runtime joins earn no labour saving beyond the assembler's actual comparison interactions.
All shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates. No ordinary author save is split off or gated because this task establishes no new record transaction.
unknowns: Coverage of released variant links and unmatched references
research_questions: Does native variant retrieval prevent use of a superseded drawing?
Time interpretation separately from explicit part-number cross-checks for repeat jobs and prototypes

already_counted.description: Document validation, manual reference capture, full match checking and unmatched-reference repair.

incremental.description: Check released-variant links and comparison settings after engineering data changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three navigation and 20 explicit comparison points, less one upkeep. Conservative prototype has poorly linked documents and few standard component references: only one navigation point and three comparison points disappear, leaving 3 net. Drawing interpretation and sequence decisions remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A technically accountable assembler who retrieves released information more directly and checks explicit matches rather than repeating them.
skills_to_grow: Validate variant and drawing revision links
Distinguish explicit identifier matches from inferred component suitability
role.ambitious_version: Make released assembly information easier to inspect while protecting drawing interpretation and practical sequence decisions.
